-- Studio always uses a separate store. Never point tests at live account data.
return {
 StoreName="HunDinoProfiles_v1",
 StudioStoreName="HunDinoProfiles_Studio_v1",
 Scope="accounts",
 AutoSaveSeconds=30,
 DebounceSeconds=2,
 LeaseSeconds=120,
 RetrySeconds=10,
 -- Only for explicit Studio QA. Native saved configuration must remain false.
 StudioMemoryTest=false,
}

-- Durable account format. Pure data only: usable in Studio and in Lune tests.
-- Economy remains authoritative for its own migrations, transactions and receipts.
local ProfileSchema = {}
local VERSION = 1
local MAX_TIME = 253402300799
local MAX_COUNT = 1000000000
local MAX_SERIAL = 2147483647
local WEAPONS = {Hammer=true, SwordShield=true, Katana=true, Glaive=true,
	DualDaggers=true, Bow=true, GreatAxe=true}
local ARMORS = {Training=true, Leather=true, Metal=true, Bone=true, None=true}
local SLOTS = {"Head", "Chest", "Arms", "Waist", "Legs"}
local FIELDS = {DataVersion=true, Economy=true, Loadout=true, Preferences=true,
	Pet=true, Statistics=true, CreatedAt=true, UpdatedAt=true}

local function integer(value, maximum)
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0
		and value <= maximum and value % 1 == 0
end

local function clone(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}
	for key, child in value do copy[key] = clone(child) end
	return copy
end

-- Reject cycles, executable values, metatables and invalid floats before cloning.
-- The bounded depth also keeps malformed input from exhausting the Lua stack.
local function plain(value, visiting, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then return value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
	if kind ~= "table" then return kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" end
	if depth > 24 or visiting[value] or getmetatable(value) ~= nil then return false end
	visiting[value] = true
	for key, child in value do
		if (type(key) ~= "string" and not integer(key, MAX_TIME))
			or not plain(child, visiting, depth + 1) then
			visiting[value] = nil
			return false
		end
	end
	visiting[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function exactFields(value, names)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
	local allowed = {}
	for _, name in names do allowed[name] = true; if value[name] == nil then return false end end
	for key in value do if not allowed[key] then return false end end
	return true
end

local function armor(kind)
	local result = {}
	for _, slot in SLOTS do result[slot] = kind end
	return result
end

local function validArmor(value)
	if not exactFields(value, SLOTS) then return false end
	for _, slot in SLOTS do if not ARMORS[value[slot]] then return false end end
	return true
end

-- Numeric dictionary keys are unsafe through Roblox JSON/DataStore serialization.
-- Decode only canonical positive decimal keys, rejecting aliases/collisions.
local function decodeOperations(economy)
	if type(economy) ~= "table" or type(economy.OperationReceipts) ~= "table" then return false end
	local decoded = {}
	for key, receipt in economy.OperationReceipts do
		local n
		if type(key) == "number" then n = key
		elseif type(key) == "string" and key:match("^[1-9]%d*$") then n = tonumber(key) end
		if not integer(n, MAX_SERIAL) or n == 0 or decoded[n] ~= nil
			or (type(key) == "string" and tostring(n) ~= key) then return false end
		decoded[n] = receipt
	end
	economy.OperationReceipts = decoded
	return true
end

function ProfileSchema.new(economyRules)
	assert(type(economyRules) == "table" and type(economyRules.new) == "function"
		and type(economyRules.apply) == "function", "Economy rules are required")
	local schema = {DataVersion = VERSION}

	function schema.Default(nowUnix)
		assert(integer(nowUnix, MAX_TIME), "Default requires a Unix timestamp")
		return {DataVersion=VERSION, Economy=economyRules.new(),
			Loadout={WeaponId="Hammer", PetWeaponId="Hammer", PlayerArmor=armor("Training"), PetArmor=armor("Metal")},
			Preferences={ShowComboGuide=true, ShowDamage=true, ShowComboFX=true, AimSensitivity=1},
			Pet={HealReadyAt=0}, Statistics={HuntsCompleted=0, HuntsFailed=0, Captures=0},
			CreatedAt=nowUnix, UpdatedAt=nowUnix}
	end

	function schema.Validate(data)
		if type(data) ~= "table" or not plain(data, {}, 0) then return nil, "InvalidProfile" end
		if data.DataVersion ~= VERSION then
			return nil, if integer(data.DataVersion, MAX_SERIAL) and data.DataVersion > VERSION then "FutureDataVersion" else "InvalidDataVersion"
		end
		for field in FIELDS do if data[field] == nil then return nil, "MissingField:" .. field end end
		for field in data do if not FIELDS[field] then return nil, "UnknownField:" .. tostring(field) end end
		if not integer(data.CreatedAt, MAX_TIME) or not integer(data.UpdatedAt, MAX_TIME)
			or data.UpdatedAt < data.CreatedAt then return nil, "InvalidTimestamps" end
		local loadout = data.Loadout
		if not exactFields(loadout, {"WeaponId", "PetWeaponId", "PlayerArmor", "PetArmor"})
			or not WEAPONS[loadout.WeaponId] or not WEAPONS[loadout.PetWeaponId]
			or not validArmor(loadout.PlayerArmor) or not validArmor(loadout.PetArmor) then return nil, "InvalidLoadout" end
		local preferences = data.Preferences
		if not exactFields(preferences, {"ShowComboGuide", "ShowDamage", "ShowComboFX", "AimSensitivity"})
			or type(preferences.ShowComboGuide) ~= "boolean" or type(preferences.ShowDamage) ~= "boolean"
			or type(preferences.ShowComboFX) ~= "boolean"
			or (preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 0.5 and preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 0.75 and preferences.AimSensitivity ~= 1) then
			return nil, "InvalidPreferences"
		end
		if not exactFields(data.Pet, {"HealReadyAt"}) or not integer(data.Pet.HealReadyAt, MAX_TIME) then return nil, "InvalidPet" end
		if not exactFields(data.Statistics, {"HuntsCompleted", "HuntsFailed", "Captures"}) then return nil, "InvalidStatistics" end
		for _, value in data.Statistics do if not integer(value, MAX_COUNT) then return nil, "InvalidStatistics" end end
		local normalized = clone(data)
		if not decodeOperations(normalized.Economy) then return nil, "InvalidOperationReceipts" end
		local economy, reason = economyRules.new(normalized.Economy)
		if not economy then return nil, "Economy:" .. tostring(reason) end
		normalized.Economy = economy
		return normalized
	end

	function schema.Encode(data)
		local encoded, reason = schema.Validate(data)
		if not encoded then return nil, reason end
		local receipts = {}
		for key, receipt in encoded.Economy.OperationReceipts do receipts[tostring(key)] = receipt end
		encoded.Economy.OperationReceipts = receipts
		return encoded
	end

	-- Loading never resumes a half-finished hunt: only its unspent reserved items
	-- return. Committed loot and claim ledgers remain intact, without new rewards.
	-- The caller must durably save this repaired profile before permitting actions.
	function schema.Recover(data)
		local recovered, reason = schema.Validate(data)
		if not recovered then return nil, reason end
		local run = recovered.Economy.ActiveRun
		if not run then return recovered end
		local request = {Op="CloseRun", RunId=run.Id, RunSerial=run.Serial}
		if run.State == "Preparing" then request.EntryFailed = true
		else request.Traps, request.Potions = run.Traps, run.Potions end
		local receipt = economyRules.apply(recovered.Economy, request)
		if not receipt.Ok then return nil, "RecoveryFailed:" .. tostring(receipt.Code) end
  if run.State=="Hunting" then recovered.Statistics.HuntsFailed=math.min(MAX_COUNT,recovered.Statistics.HuntsFailed+1) end
		return recovered, receipt
	end

	schema.Decode = schema.Validate
	return schema
end

return ProfileSchema

-- Server-only durable profile repository. The UpdateAsync callback must not yield.
-- Token must be unique to this server/session; Now uses Unix seconds. Inject Store,
-- Sleep and Now in tests. Validate migrates/sanitizes memory data; Encode converts it
-- to DataStore-safe tables. No load error ever becomes a new/default profile.
local Store = {}
Store.__index = Store

local MAX_INTEGER = 9007199254740991
local RECEIPT_LIMIT = 32
local function integer(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 0 and n <= MAX_INTEGER and n % 1 == 0
end

local function copy(value, seen, depth)
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "nil" or kind == "string" or kind == "boolean" then return value end
	if kind == "number" then
		assert(value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge, "Non-finite data")
		return value
	end
	assert(kind == "table" and (depth or 0) < 48, "Unsupported profile data/depth")
	seen = seen or {}
	assert(not seen[value], "Cyclic profile data")
	seen[value] = true
	local result = {}
	for key, item in value do
		assert(type(key) == "string" or (integer(key) and key > 0), "Invalid profile key")
		result[key] = copy(item, seen, (depth or 0) + 1)
	end
	seen[value] = nil
	return result
end

local function serializable(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return end
	local strings, numbers, count, maximum = false, false, 0, 0
	for key, item in value do
		if type(key) == "string" then strings = true else numbers = true; maximum = math.max(maximum, key) end
		count += 1
		serializable(item)
	end
	assert(not (strings and numbers) and (not numbers or count == maximum), "Encode must return dictionaries or dense arrays")
end

local function equal(a, b)
	if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
	if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
	for key, item in a do if not equal(item, b[key]) then return false end end
	for key in b do if a[key] == nil then return false end end
	return true
end

function Store.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and options.Store ~= nil, "Store required")
	assert(type(options.Token) == "string" and #options.Token > 0 and #options.Token <= 160, "Unique session Token required")
	local self = setmetatable({}, Store)
	self._store, self._token = options.Store, options.Token
	self._now = options.Now or os.time
	self._sleep = options.Sleep or function(seconds) task.wait(seconds) end
	self._validate, self._encode = options.Validate, options.Encode
	self._lease = options.LeaseSeconds or 120
	self._attempts = options.MaxAttempts or 4
	self._baseDelay, self._maxDelay = options.BaseDelay or 0.5, options.MaxDelay or 4
	assert(type(self._lease) == "number" and self._lease >= 10 and self._lease <= 3600, "LeaseSeconds must be 10..3600")
	assert(integer(self._attempts) and self._attempts >= 1 and self._attempts <= 8, "MaxAttempts must be 1..8")
	assert(type(self._baseDelay) == "number" and self._baseDelay >= 0 and self._baseDelay <= 10
		and type(self._maxDelay) == "number" and self._maxDelay >= self._baseDelay and self._maxDelay <= 30, "Invalid retry delays")
	self._states, self._serial = {}, 0
	return self
end

function Store:_data(data)
	local ok, result, code = pcall(function()
		local candidate = copy(data)
		if type(candidate) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidData" end
		if self._validate then
			local normalized, reason = self._validate(candidate)
			if type(normalized) ~= "table" then return nil, reason or "InvalidData" end
			candidate = copy(normalized)
		end
		return candidate
	end)
	if not ok then return nil, "InvalidData" end
	return result, code
end

function Store:_encoded(data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
		local result = copy(if self._encode then self._encode(copy(data)) else data)
		assert(type(result) == "table", "Encode returned no data")
		serializable(result)
		return result
	end)
	return if ok then encoded else nil
end

function Store:_envelope(raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if integer(raw.FormatVersion) and raw.FormatVersion > 1 then return nil, "FutureFormat" end
	if raw.FormatVersion ~= 1 or not integer(raw.Revision) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if raw.Session ~= nil and (type(raw.Session) ~= "table" or type(raw.Session.Token) ~= "string"
		or #raw.Session.Token == 0 or not integer(raw.Session.ExpiresAt)) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	local function validReceipt(mark)
		return type(mark) == "table" and type(mark.Id) == "string" and #mark.Id > 0
			and type(mark.Token) == "string" and #mark.Token > 0 and integer(mark.Revision)
			and mark.Revision <= raw.Revision and type(mark.Released) == "boolean"
	end
	if raw.LastCommit ~= nil and not validReceipt(raw.LastCommit) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	if raw.RecentCommits ~= nil then
		if type(raw.RecentCommits) ~= "table" or #raw.RecentCommits > RECEIPT_LIMIT then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
		local count = 0
		for key, mark in raw.RecentCommits do
			count += 1
			if not integer(key) or key < 1 or key > #raw.RecentCommits or not validReceipt(mark) then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
		end
		if count ~= #raw.RecentCommits then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	end
	local data, reason = self:_data(raw.Data)
	if not data then return nil, reason end
	local ok, envelope = pcall(copy, raw)
	if not ok then return nil, "InvalidEnvelope" end
	return envelope, nil, data
end

function Store:_begin(key)
	assert(type(key) == "string" and #key > 0, "Profile key required")
	local state = self._states[key]
	if not state then state = {}; self._states[key] = state end
	if state.Busy then return nil, "Busy" end
	state.Busy = true
	return state
end

function Store:_retry(callback, failureCode)
	for attempt = 1, self._attempts do
		local ok, value, reason = pcall(callback)
		if ok then return value, reason end
		if attempt < self._attempts then
			self._sleep(math.min(self._maxDelay, self._baseDelay * 2 ^ (attempt - 1)))
		end
	end
	return nil, failureCode
end

local function receipt(envelope, id)
	if type(envelope.LastCommit) == "table" and envelope.LastCommit.Id == id then return envelope.LastCommit end
	if type(envelope.RecentCommits) == "table" then
		for _, item in envelope.RecentCommits do
			if type(item) == "table" and item.Id == id then return item end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Explicit acquisition is the only operation allowed to take an expired lease.
function Store:Load(key, defaultData)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	if state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return true, "Loaded", copy(state.Data) end
	local default, invalid = self:_data(defaultData)
	local encoded = if default then self:_encoded(default) else nil
	if not encoded then state.Busy = nil; return false, invalid or "InvalidData" end
	local created = false
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local now = self._now()
			local envelope, why
			if raw == nil then
				created = true
				envelope = {FormatVersion = 1, Data = copy(encoded), Revision = 0}
			else envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw) end
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			if envelope.Session and envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token and envelope.Session.ExpiresAt > now then
				rejected = "Locked"; return nil
			end
			-- Keep commit receipts when acquiring: a previous owner's lost release response
			-- can still be acknowledged without modifying this new owner's session.
			envelope.Session = {Token = self._token, ExpiresAt = now + self._lease}
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "LoadFailed")
	if result == nil then state.Busy = nil; return false, failure or "LoadFailed" end
	local envelope, why, normalized = self:_envelope(result)
	if not envelope or not envelope.Session or envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token then
		state.Busy = nil; return false, why or "SessionLost"
	end
	state.Loaded, state.Data, state.Revision = true, normalized, envelope.Revision
	state.Pending, state.Released, state.Busy = nil, nil, nil
	return true, if created then "Created" else "Loaded", copy(normalized)
end

function Store:_commit(key, state, pending)
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw)
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			if receipt(envelope, pending.Id) then return envelope end
			local now, session = self._now(), envelope.Session
			if not session or session.Token ~= self._token or session.ExpiresAt <= now then rejected = "SessionLost"; return nil end
			if envelope.Revision ~= pending.Revision then rejected = "RevisionConflict"; return nil end
			if pending.Revision >= MAX_INTEGER then rejected = "RevisionLimit"; return nil end
			envelope.Data, envelope.Revision = copy(pending.Encoded), pending.Revision + 1
			envelope.Session = if pending.Release then nil else {Token = self._token, ExpiresAt = now + self._lease}
			local mark = {Id = pending.Id, Token = self._token, Revision = envelope.Revision, Released = pending.Release}
			local history = if type(envelope.RecentCommits) == "table" then envelope.RecentCommits else {}
			table.insert(history, copy(mark))
			while #history > RECEIPT_LIMIT do table.remove(history, 1) end
			envelope.LastCommit, envelope.RecentCommits = mark, history
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "SaveFailed")
	if result == nil then
		if failure ~= "SaveFailed" then state.Loaded, state.Pending = false, nil end
		return false, failure or "SaveFailed"
	end
	local envelope, why = self:_envelope(result)
	local committed = if envelope then receipt(envelope, pending.Id) else nil
	if not committed then state.Loaded, state.Pending = false, nil; return false, why or "RevisionConflict" end
	state.Data, state.Revision, state.Pending = copy(pending.Data), committed.Revision, nil
	if pending.Release then state.Loaded, state.Released = false, true; return true, "Released", copy(state.Data) end
	if not envelope.Session or envelope.Session.Token ~= self._token or envelope.Session.ExpiresAt <= self._now() then
		state.Loaded = false; return false, "SessionLost"
	end
	return true, "Saved", copy(state.Data)
end

function Store:Save(key, data, release)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	-- Release is itself idempotent, even after the lock has been removed.
	if state.Released then state.Busy = nil; return true, "Released", copy(state.Data) end
	if not state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return false, "NotLoaded" end
	local normalized, invalid = self:_data(data)
	local encoded = if normalized then self:_encoded(normalized) else nil
	if not encoded then state.Busy = nil; return false, invalid or "InvalidData" end
	if state.Pending then
		local previous = state.Pending
		local ok, status, committed = self:_commit(key, state, previous)
		if not ok or previous.Release or (not release and equal(normalized, previous.Data)) then
			state.Busy = nil; return ok, status, committed
		end
	end
	self._serial += 1
	local pending = {Id = self._token .. ":" .. self._serial, Revision = state.Revision,
		Data = copy(normalized), Encoded = encoded, Release = release == true}
	state.Pending = pending
	local ok, status, committed = self:_commit(key, state, pending)
	state.Busy = nil
	return ok, status, committed
end

-- Renew at an interval comfortably below LeaseSeconds (for example every 30s).
-- A pending save is resolved by Save, so it cannot be silently replaced by Renew.
function Store:Renew(key)
	local state, reason = self:_begin(key)
	if not state then return false, reason end
	if not state.Loaded then state.Busy = nil; return false, "NotLoaded" end
	if state.Pending then state.Busy = nil; return false, "PendingSave" end
	local result, failure = self:_retry(function()
		local rejected
		local value = self._store:UpdateAsync(key, function(raw)
			local envelope, why = self:_envelope(raw)
			if not envelope then rejected = why; return nil end
			local now, session = self._now(), envelope.Session
			if not session or session.Token ~= self._token or session.ExpiresAt <= now then rejected = "SessionLost"; return nil end
			if envelope.Revision ~= state.Revision then rejected = "RevisionConflict"; return nil end
			envelope.Session.ExpiresAt = now + self._lease
			return envelope
		end)
		return value, rejected
	end, "RenewFailed")
	state.Busy = nil
	if result == nil then
		if failure ~= "RenewFailed" then state.Loaded = false end
		return false, failure or "RenewFailed"
	end
	return true, "Renewed", copy(state.Data)
end

return Store

-- One canonical account per player. Economic changes are committed before success.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Store=require(script.Parent.ProfileStore)
local Schema=require(script.Parent.ProfileSchema)
local Config=require(script.Parent.ProfileConfig)
local Economy=require(game.ServerScriptService.HuntingRuntime.HuntEconomyRules)
local Service={}
Service.__index=Service
local SLOTS={"Head","Chest","Arms","Waist","Legs"}
local PREFS={ShowComboGuide=true,ShowDamage=true,ShowComboFX=true,AimSensitivity=true}
local TEXT={
 Loading="Đang tải tiến trình tài khoản…",Loaded="Đã tải tiến trình.",
 Dirty="Có thay đổi, đang chờ lưu…",Saving="Đang lưu tiến trình…",Saved="Đã lưu tiến trình.",
 Error="Chưa lưu được. Đã giữ bản đang chờ; hãy thử lưu lại.",
 Unavailable="Map chưa xuất bản. Cần xuất bản game để dùng lưu tài khoản.",
 Conflict="Hồ sơ đang được dùng ở máy chủ khác. Hãy chờ rồi thử tải lại.",
 Closing="Đang lưu trước khi rời…",
}
local function set(p,k,v) if p.Parent and p:GetAttribute(k)~=v then p:SetAttribute(k,v) end end
local function replace(dst,src) table.clear(dst);for k,v in src do dst[k]=v end end
local function copy(value)
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local out={};for k,v in value do out[k]=copy(v) end;return out
end
function Service.new(options)
 local self=setmetatable({Entries={},Connections={},Schema=Schema.new(Economy),Now=os.time,
  ServerNow=function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end,Mode="DataStore",Stopped=false},Service)
 for k,v in options or {} do self[k]=v end
 self.Remote=Instance.new("RemoteEvent");self.Remote.Name="HunDinoProfileAction";self.Remote.Parent=ReplicatedStorage
 table.insert(self.Connections,self.Remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,action,key,value)
  self:Request(p,action,key,value)
 end))
 Service.Current=self
 task.spawn(function()
  while not self.Stopped do
   task.wait(1)
   local now=os.clock()
   for p,e in self.Entries do
    if e.Ready and not e.Saving and not e.Closing and
     ((e.DirtyAt and now>=e.DirtyAt+Config.DebounceSeconds) or now>=e.NextSave) then
     e.DirtyAt=nil
     task.spawn(function() self:Save(p) end)
    end
   end
  end
 end)
 return self
end
function Service:_repository()
 if self.Repository then return self.Repository end
 local backend
 if RunService:IsStudio() and (Config.StudioMemoryTest or script.Parent:GetAttribute("StudioMemoryTest")==true) then
  -- Deliberately explicit QA mode, never an automatic fallback after a DS error.
  self.TestRecords=self.TestRecords or {}
  local records=self.TestRecords
  backend={UpdateAsync=function(_,key,transform)
   if (self.TestFailWrites or 0)>0 then self.TestFailWrites-=1;error("Injected Studio QA outage") end
   local result=transform(copy(records[key]))
   if result~=nil then records[key]=copy(result) end
   return copy(result)
  end}
  self.Mode="TestMemory"
  local probe=Instance.new("BindableFunction");probe.Name="StudioProfileProbe";probe.Parent=script.Parent
  probe.OnInvoke=function(action,p,value)
   if action=="Snapshot" then return copy(self:Data(p)) end
   if action=="Save" then return self:Save(p) end
   if action=="Reload" then self:Release(p);return self:Load(p) end
   if action=="Outage" then self.TestFailWrites=value;return true end
   if action=="Records" then return copy(self.TestRecords) end
  end
 else
  if game.GameId==0 or game.PlaceId==0 then return nil,"Unavailable" end
  local ok,result=pcall(function()
   return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(if RunService:IsStudio() then Config.StudioStoreName else Config.StoreName,Config.Scope)
  end)
  if not ok then return nil,"Unavailable" end
  backend=result
 end
 self.Repository=Store.new({Store=backend,Token=game.JobId..":"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),

local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)

	sync(s)
end
local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z

local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)

end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator
	if not animator or animator:IsAttacking() then return end
	s.PetTarget = target
	local count = animator:GetHitCount()
	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end
		-- Split the original total damage across the two dagger strikes.
		local amount = math.floor(Config.PetDamage / count)
			+ (if index <= Config.PetDamage % count then 1 else 0)
		hit(s, target, amount, true)
		if s.PetWeaponId == "Bow" then remote:FireAllClients("Shot", center, point, false) end
	end
	if animator:Attack() then
		s.PetClock = os.clock() + Config.PetInterval
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", s.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") + 1)
	end
end
local function attack(s, action, direction, releasedKind, releasedSpec)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not (s.InTraining or s.InHunting) or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind,spec=releasedKind,releasedSpec
	if not kind then kind,spec=Rules.attack(Config,Weapons,s,action,now) end
	if not kind then return end
	local attackDamage=spec.Damage*(if s.WeaponId=="Hammer" and economy then economy:DamageMultiplier(s.Player) else 1)
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration", spec.Duration)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackWindup", spec.Windup)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.Shots else spec.Hits) or 1)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.ShotInterval else spec.HitInterval) or (if weapon.Ranged then (if s.InHunting then .09 else 0) else 0.13))
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence", (s.WeaponModel:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local attackToken=tostring(s.Player.UserId)..":"..string.format("%.6f",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())..":"..serial
	local function forestHit(applied,point)
		if applied>0 then
			s.HuntEngagedUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 25
			s.Player:SetAttribute("HuntingDamage",(s.Player:GetAttribute("HuntingDamage") or 0)+applied)
			remote:FireAllClients("Hit",point,applied,false)
		end
	end
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and (spec.ShotInterval or s.InHunting) then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval or .09) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					if s.InHunting and dinosaurCombat:FromRayHit(result.Instance) then
						local amount=math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5)
						if dinosaurCombat:CanHit(s.Player,result.Position,spec.Range+2) then
							forestHit(dinosaurCombat:Damage(s.Player,amount,result.Position,attackToken..":arrow:"..i),result.Position)
						end
					end
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if s.InTraining and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break
					end end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			if s.InHunting then
				local applied,point=dinosaurCombat:MeleeStrike(s.Player,s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0),direction,
					spec.Range,spec.Arc or .3,attackDamage,attackToken..":melee:"..n)
				if applied>0 then forestHit(applied,point) end
			end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if s.InTraining and delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, attackDamage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(spec.Duration, function()
		if states[s.Player] ~= s or not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {C0 = s.RestPose}):Play()
		if s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.12),{C0=s.OffRest}):Play() end
		s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end)
	sync(s)
end

		s.Grip.Part0 = torso
		s.RestPose = CFrame.new(.5, -1, 1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-30))
	end
	s.Grip.C0 = s.RestPose
	if s.OffGrip then
		s.OffGrip.Part0 = if s.Drawn then left else torso
		s.OffRest = if s.Drawn then CFrame.new(0, -.3, -.35) else CFrame.new(-.7, -.7, 1.3)
		s.OffGrip.C0 = if s.Blocking then CFrame.new(.5,.5,-1) * CFrame.Angles(0,-.3,0) else s.OffRest
	end
	if s.SheathGrip then s.SheathGrip.Part0 = torso; s.SheathGrip.C0 = CFrame.new(.5,-1,1.04)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-30)) end

local function createWeapon(s)

	s.OffGrip = nil; s.SheathGrip = nil
	local model = weaponTemplates[s.WeaponId]:Clone(); model.Name = "TrainingWeapon"
	for _, assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local handle = assembly.PrimaryPart
		for _, p in assembly:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Anchored = false; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Massless = true
				if p ~= handle and not p:FindFirstChild("KatanaWeld") and not p:FindFirstChild("WeaponProWeld") then weld(handle,p,handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)) end
			end
		end
		local grip = weld(s.Root,handle,CFrame.new())
		if assembly.Name == "Main" then s.Grip = grip elseif assembly.Name == "Offhand" then s.OffGrip = grip else s.SheathGrip = grip end
	end
	model.Parent = s.Character; s.WeaponModel = model; weaponPose(s)
end

local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)
	updateDummy(dummy)
	remote:FireAllClients("Hit", dummy.Target.Position, applied, isPet)
	sync(s)
end
local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 2 and math.abs(v.Z) < 2 and math.abs(v.Y) < (if ranged then 2 else .01) and v.Magnitude > 0.5
end
local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}

end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator
	if not animator or animator:IsAttacking() then return end
	s.PetTarget = target
	local count = animator:GetHitCount()
	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end
		-- Split the original total damage across the two dagger strikes.
		local amount = math.floor(Config.PetDamage / count)
			+ (if index <= Config.PetDamage % count then 1 else 0)
		hit(s, target, amount, true)
		if s.PetWeaponId == "Bow" then remote:FireAllClients("Shot", center, point, false) end
	end
	if animator:Attack() then
		s.PetClock = os.clock() + Config.PetInterval
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", s.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") + 1)
	end
end
local function attack(s, action, direction, releasedKind, releasedSpec)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not (s.InTraining or s.InHunting) or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind,spec=releasedKind,releasedSpec
	if not kind then kind,spec=Rules.attack(Config,Weapons,s,action,now) end
	if not kind then return end
	local attackDamage=spec.Damage*(if s.WeaponId=="Hammer" and economy then economy:DamageMultiplier(s.Player) else 1)
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackDuration", spec.Duration)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackWindup", spec.Windup)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHits", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.Shots else spec.Hits) or 1)
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackHitInterval", (if weapon.Ranged then spec.ShotInterval else spec.HitInterval) or (if weapon.Ranged then (if s.InHunting then .09 else 0) else 0.13))
	s.WeaponModel:SetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence", (s.WeaponModel:GetAttribute("WeaponAttackSequence") or 0) + 1)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local attackToken=tostring(s.Player.UserId)..":"..string.format("%.6f",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())..":"..serial
	local function forestHit(applied,point)
		if applied>0 then
			s.HuntEngagedUntil = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 25
			s.Player:SetAttribute("HuntingDamage",(s.Player:GetAttribute("HuntingDamage") or 0)+applied)
			remote:FireAllClients("Hit",point,applied,false)
		end
	end
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and (spec.ShotInterval or s.InHunting) then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval or .09) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					if s.InHunting and dinosaurCombat:FromRayHit(result.Instance) then
						local amount=math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5)
						if dinosaurCombat:CanHit(s.Player,result.Position,spec.Range+2) then
							forestHit(dinosaurCombat:Damage(s.Player,amount,result.Position,attackToken..":arrow:"..i),result.Position)
						end
					end
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if s.InTraining and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break
					end end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			if s.InHunting then
				local applied,point=dinosaurCombat:MeleeStrike(s.Player,s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0),direction,
					spec.Range,spec.Arc or .3,attackDamage,attackToken..":melee:"..n)
				if applied>0 then forestHit(applied,point) end
			end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if s.InTraining and delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, attackDamage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(spec.Duration, function()
		if states[s.Player] ~= s or not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {C0 = s.RestPose}):Play()
		if s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.12),{C0=s.OffRest}):Play() end
		s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end)
	sync(s)
end

	local player, run = entry.Player, entry.Run

	set(player, "QuestTarget", "T-REX · Không hệ")
	set(player, "QuestState", run.State); set(player, "QuestResult", run.Result)
	set(player, "QuestDeaths", run.Deaths); set(player, "QuestDeadline", run.Deadline)
	set(player, "QuestHarvestUntil", run.HarvestUntil or 0)
	set(player, "QuestFailureReason", run.FailureReason)
	set(player, "HuntTraps", run.Traps); set(player, "HuntPotions", run.Potions)
	if not run.Action then set(player, "HuntCaptureActive", false) end

		or s.Drawn or s.ChangeDraw ~= nil or s.Charge or s.Blocking or s.Sprinting
		or os.clock() < s.BusyUntil or player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true then
		return false, "Về sảnh, cất vũ khí và dừng động tác để nhận nhiệm vụ."
	end

function Service:_canUseItems(entry)
	local s = self.GetState(entry.Player)

		and not s.Blocking and not s.Sprinting and os.clock() >= s.BusyUntil

function Service:_capture(entry)
	if self.Active ~= entry or entry.Run.Result ~= "Captured" then return end

end
function Service:_result(entry)
	if entry.ResultPublished then return end
	if self.Economy and not self.Economy:Result(entry.Player,entry.Run) then return end
	entry.ResultPublished = true
	self.Session:FreezeClock(entry.Player)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", false)
	self.Combat:PlayerExited(entry.Player)
	if entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Cancel("Result") end
	set(entry.Player, "HuntCaptureActive", false)
	if self.OnResult then self.OnResult(entry.Player) end

	self:_publish(entry)
end
function Service:Accept(player)
	local ready, reason = self:_lobbyReady(player)
	if not ready then self.Message(player, reason); return false end
	if self.Active and not self.Active.Run.Closed then self.Message(player, "Chỉ có một lượt săn thử solo tại một thời điểm."); return false end
	if self.Session.Count ~= 0 then self.Message(player, "Khu săn cần trống trước khi nhận nhiệm vụ solo."); return false end
	local run = self.Rules.new(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), now())
	if self.Economy then
		local prepared, reason = self.Economy:Begin(player,run)
		if not prepared then self.Message(player,reason); return false end
	end
	local entry = {Player = player, Run = run}
	self.Active = entry
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestOwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", true)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("MonsterInstanceId", run.MonsterId)
	self:_publish(entry)
	task.spawn(function()
		local moved = self.Travel(player, "Hunting", nil, "Hạ hoặc bắt T-REX. Quặng ở phía bắc trại; đồ nhặt được giữ cả khi thua.")
		task.wait(.55)
		if self.Active ~= entry or run.Closed then return end
		local s = self.GetState(player)
		if not moved or not alive(s) or not s.InHunting then
			self.Rules.fail(run, "EntryInterrupted", now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		if not self.Rules.start(run, now()) then return end
		if self.Economy and not self.Economy:Start(player,run) then
			self.Rules.fail(run,"EntryInterrupted",now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		self.Session:RestartClock(player, self.Rules.Config.Duration)
		entry.Capture = CaptureController.new({
			Player = player, Run = run, Rules = self.Rules, Combat = self.Combat,
			Forest = self.Forest, PetFolder = self.PetFolder,
			Character = function() local state = self.GetState(player); return state and state.Character end,
			CanUseItems = function() return self:_canUseItems(entry) end,
			CanCapture = function() return self.Economy:CanCapture(player,run) end,
			OnCapture = function() self:_capture(entry) end,
			OnMessage = function(text) self.Message(player, text) end,
		})
		local harvestReady,harvest=pcall(HarvestController.new,{
			Player=player,Run=run,Combat=self.Combat,Forest=self.Forest,PetFolder=self.PetFolder,
			Character=function() local s=self.GetState(player);return s and s.Character end,
			CanInteract=function() return self:_canHarvest(entry) end,
			Grant=function(kind,sourceId,index) return self.Economy:Grant(player,run,kind,sourceId,index) end,
			OnMessage=function(text) self.Message(player,text) end,
		})
		if not harvestReady then
			warn("[P1-E] Harvest preparation failed",harvest)
			self.Rules.fail(run,"EntryInterrupted",now());self:_result(entry);return
		end
		entry.Harvest=harvest
		self:_publish(entry)
	end)
	return true
end
function Service:CancelAction(player, reason)
	local entry = self.Active
	if entry and entry.Player == player and entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Cancel(reason) end
	if entry and entry.Player == player and entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Cancel(reason) end
end
function Service:_canHarvest(entry)
	local s=self.GetState(entry.Player);local run=entry.Run
	return self.Active==entry and (run.State=="Hunting" or run.State=="Harvest") and alive(s) and s.InHunting
		and not s.Travelling and not s.Drawn and s.ChangeDraw==nil and not s.Charge and not s.Blocking
		and not s.Sprinting and os.clock()>=s.BusyUntil and os.clock()>=(s.DodgingUntil or 0)
		and entry.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying")~=true and not run.Action
end
function Service:HarvestAction(player,action)
	local entry=self.Active;if not entry or entry.Player~=player or not entry.Harvest then return end
	if action=="CarveStart" then entry.Harvest:RequestCarve(now()) else entry.Harvest:Cancel() end

function Service:ItemAction(player, action)
	local entry = self.Active
	if not entry or entry.Player ~= player or not entry.Capture then return end
	if action == "TrapPlaceStart" then entry.Capture:RequestPlace(now())
	elseif action == "CaptureStart" then entry.Capture:RequestCapture(now())

	local entry = self.Active

	self:CancelAction(player, "Dead")

	if result == "Camp" then
		self.Combat:PlayerExited(player)
		set(player, "QuestRespawnAt", now() + self.Rules.Config.RespawnDelay)

end

	end

	if entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Destroy();entry.Harvest=nil end

	if self.OnResult then self.OnResult(entry.Player) end

	self:_publish(entry)
end
function Service:Accept(player)
	local ready, reason = self:_lobbyReady(player)
	if not ready then self.Message(player, reason); return false end
	if self.Active and not self.Active.Run.Closed then self.Message(player, "Chỉ có một lượt săn thử solo tại một thời điểm."); return false end
	if self.Session.Count ~= 0 then self.Message(player, "Khu săn cần trống trước khi nhận nhiệm vụ solo."); return false end
	local run = self.Rules.new(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), now())
	if self.Economy then
		local prepared, reason = self.Economy:Begin(player,run)
		if not prepared then self.Message(player,reason); return false end
	end
	local entry = {Player = player, Run = run}
	self.Active = entry
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestOwnerUserId", player.UserId)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", true)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("MonsterInstanceId", run.MonsterId)
	self:_publish(entry)
	task.spawn(function()
		local moved = self.Travel(player, "Hunting", nil, "Hạ hoặc bắt T-REX. Quặng ở phía bắc trại; đồ nhặt được giữ cả khi thua.")
		task.wait(.55)

		local s = self.GetState(player)
		if not moved or not alive(s) or not s.InHunting then
			self.Rules.fail(run, "EntryInterrupted", now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		if not self.Rules.start(run, now()) then return end
		if self.Economy and not self.Economy:Start(player,run) then
			self.Rules.fail(run,"EntryInterrupted",now()); self:_result(entry); return
		end
		self.Session:RestartClock(player, self.Rules.Config.Duration)
		entry.Capture = CaptureController.new({
			Player = player, Run = run, Rules = self.Rules, Combat = self.Combat,
			Forest = self.Forest, PetFolder = self.PetFolder,
			Character = function() local state = self.GetState(player); return state and state.Character end,
			CanUseItems = function() return self:_canUseItems(entry) end,
			CanCapture = function() return self.Economy:CanCapture(player,run) end,
   OnItemsChanged = function() return self.Economy:Sync(player,run) end,
			OnCapture = function() self:_capture(entry) end,
			OnMessage = function(text) self.Message(player, text) end,
		})
		local harvestReady,harvest=pcall(HarvestController.new,{
			Player=player,Run=run,Combat=self.Combat,Forest=self.Forest,PetFolder=self.PetFolder,
			Character=function() local s=self.GetState(player);return s and s.Character end,
			CanInteract=function() return self:_canHarvest(entry) end,
			Grant=function(kind,sourceId,index) return self.Economy:Grant(player,run,kind,sourceId,index) end,
			OnMessage=function(text) self.Message(player,text) end,
		})
		if not harvestReady then
			warn("[P1-E] Harvest preparation failed",harvest)
			self.Rules.fail(run,"EntryInterrupted",now());self:_result(entry);return
		end
		entry.Harvest=harvest
		self:_publish(entry)
	end)
	return true
end
function Service:CancelAction(player, reason)
	local entry = self.Active
	if entry and entry.Player == player and entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Cancel(reason) end
	if entry and entry.Player == player and entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Cancel(reason) end
end
function Service:_canHarvest(entry)
	local s=self.GetState(entry.Player);local run=entry.Run
	return self.Active==entry and (run.State=="Hunting" or run.State=="Harvest") and alive(s) and s.InHunting
		and not s.Travelling and not s.Drawn and s.ChangeDraw==nil and not s.Charge and not s.Blocking

function Service:ObserveDamage(player,beforeHP,afterHP)

function Service:ItemAction(player, action)
	local entry = self.Active

	if action == "TrapPlaceStart" then entry.Capture:RequestPlace(now())
	elseif action == "CaptureStart" then entry.Capture:RequestCapture(now())

function Service:PlayerDied(player)
	local entry = self.Active

	if result == "Camp" then
		self.Combat:PlayerExited(player)

end

	if entry.Run.EconomyStarted and entry.Run.Result and not entry.ResultPublished then
		self:_result(entry);if not entry.ResultPublished then return false end
	end

 if self.Active~=entry then return false end
	if entry.Capture then entry.Capture:Destroy(); entry.Capture = nil end
	if entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Destroy();entry.Harvest=nil end
	self.Rules.close(entry.Run)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestOwnerUserId", nil)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("QuestCombatAllowed", nil)
	self.Combat.Model:SetAttribute("MonsterInstanceId", nil)

end

	local entry = self.Active
	if not entry or entry.Player ~= player or entry.Returning then return false end
	local s = self.GetState(player)
	if not alive(s) then entry.ReturnAfter = now(); return false end
	if entry.Run.State == "Hunting" or entry.Run.State == "Preparing" then
		self.Rules.fail(entry.Run, reason or "Abandoned", now()); self:_result(entry)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local moved = self.Travel(player, "Lobby", nil, "Đã về sảnh. Nguyên liệu và vật tư dư ở kho thử trong phiên máy chủ.")
		if self.Active ~= entry then return end

	end)

end
function Service:BeforeTravel(player, destination)
	self:CancelAction(player, "Travel")
	local entry = self.Active
	if entry and entry.Player == player and destination ~= "Hunting" and not entry.Returning then
		self:Return(player, "Abandoned"); return false
	end
	return true
end
function Service:Step(dt)
 if self._stepping then return end
 self._stepping=true
 local ok,err=xpcall(function() self:_step(dt) end,debug.traceback)
 self._stepping=false
 if not ok then warn("[HunDino Quest]",err) end
end
function Service:_step(dt)
	local entry = self.Active
	if not entry then return end
	local run, time = entry.Run, now()
	if not entry.Player.Parent then self:RemovePlayer(entry.Player); return end
	if run.State == "Hunting" and self.Combat:GetSnapshot().Health <= 0 then
		if self.Rules.finish(run, "Defeated", time) then self:_result(entry) end
	end
	self.Rules.tick(run, time)

	if entry.Harvest then entry.Harvest:Step(time,dt) end

	if run.Result and not entry.ResultPublished then self:_result(entry) end
	if run.State == "Returning" or (run.State == "Failed" and time >= (entry.ReturnAfter or math.huge)) then
		self:Return(entry.Player)
	end
	self:_publish(entry)
end

	local entry = self.Active
 if entry and entry.Player==player and not self:_close(entry) and self.Active==entry then
  -- Disk recovery owns the reserved items if a last write is still pending.

 end

-- Runtime geometry for one server-owned quest. Rules owns quantities, clocks and
-- the final result; this controller supplies real ground, movement and target checks.
local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller

local UP = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local TRAP_RADIUS = 4
local TRIGGER_RADIUS = 10
local PLACE_REACH = 5
local CAPTURE_REACH = 4
local MESSAGES = {
	NotHunting = "Chỉ dùng vật dụng trong lượt săn đang diễn ra.",
	NoTraps = "Đã hết Iron Trap. Bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
	NoPotions = "Đã hết thuốc ngủ. Bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
	Busy = "Hãy hoàn tất hoặc hủy thao tác hiện tại trước.",
	TrapActive = "Bẫy hiện tại vẫn đang chờ hoặc đang giữ mục tiêu.",
	NotTrapped = "Hãy dẫn mục tiêu vào Iron Trap trước.",
	NotWeak = "Mục tiêu cần còn sống và có không quá 10% máu.",
	TrapEscaped = "Bẫy đã hết hiệu lực; chưa dùng thuốc ngủ.",
	TrapExpired = "Bẫy đã hết thời gian chờ.",
	InvalidHealth = "Mục tiêu đã bị hạ hoặc không thể bắt.",
	ItemsBlocked = "Cất vũ khí và dừng đánh, né hoặc bay trước khi dùng vật dụng.",
	InvalidGround = "Không đặt được bẫy ở đây. Cần mặt đất phẳng, trống và ngoài trại.",
	Moved = "Đã hủy đặt bẫy vì bạn di chuyển. Chưa trừ bẫy.",
	Damaged = "Thao tác bị ngắt vì bạn bị đánh. Chưa dùng vật dụng.",
	TooFar = "Đến gần dấu miệng mục tiêu trong 4 studs để cho uống.",
	Obstructed = "Có vật cản giữa bạn và miệng mục tiêu.",
	SpecimenCapacity = "Kho cá thể đã đầy. Chưa dùng thuốc; bạn vẫn có thể tiêu diệt mục tiêu.",
}

local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function finite(n) return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge end
local function vector(v)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z)
end
local function attribute(object, key, value)
	if object and object.Parent and object:GetAttribute(key) ~= value then object:SetAttribute(key, value) end
end
local function decorate(part, name, size, cf, color, parent)
	part.Name = name; part.Size = size; part.CFrame = cf
	part.Anchored = true; part.CanCollide = false; part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false; part.CastShadow = false; part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Metal; part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

function Controller.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Controller)
	for key, value in options do self[key] = value end
	assert(self.Player and self.Run and self.Rules and self.Combat and self.Forest, "Missing capture services")
	assert(type(self.Character) == "function" and type(self.CanUseItems) == "function", "Missing capture owner")
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "HuntItems_" .. tostring(self.Player.UserId)
	folder:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id)
	folder:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId)
	folder.Parent = workspace
	self._folder = folder
	self._destroyed = false
	self._captureAvailable = false
	self:_publish()
	return self
end

function Controller:_message(reason)
	local text = MESSAGES[reason]
	if text and self.OnMessage then self.OnMessage(text) end
end
function Controller:_reject(reason)
	self:_message(reason)
	return false, reason
end
function Controller:_capacity()
	if type(self.CanCapture)~="function" then return true end
	local ok,allowed,reason=pcall(self.CanCapture)
	return ok and allowed==true,if ok then reason or "ItemsBlocked" else "ItemsBlocked"
end
function Controller:_actor()
	if self._destroyed or self.Run.State ~= "Hunting" or not self.Player.Parent
		or self.Player:GetAttribute("AdminFlying") == true or not self.CanUseItems() then return nil end
	local character = self.Character()
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not vector(root.Position) then return nil end
	return character, humanoid, root
end
function Controller:_queryParams(character, overlap)
	local params = if overlap then OverlapParams.new() else RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignored = {self._folder}
	if character then table.insert(ignored, character) end
	if self.PetFolder then table.insert(ignored, self.PetFolder) end
	if self.Combat.Model then table.insert(ignored, self.Combat.Model) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	if not overlap then params.IgnoreWater = false end
	return params
end
function Controller:_insideMap(point)
	local offset = self.Forest:GetAttribute("WorldOffset") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 6500)
	local width = self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapWidth") or 4000
	local depth = self.Forest:GetAttribute("MapDepth") or 4500
	if not vector(offset) or not finite(width) or not finite(depth) then return false end
	local localPoint = point - offset
	if math.abs(localPoint.X) + TRAP_RADIUS > width * .5
		or math.abs(localPoint.Z) + TRAP_RADIUS > depth * .5 then return false end
	local config = self.Combat.MapConfig
	if config and ((finite(config.TerrainMin) and point.Y < config.TerrainMin - 4)
		or (finite(config.TerrainMax) and point.Y > config.TerrainMax + 10)) then return false end
	local zones = self.Forest:FindFirstChild("Zones")
	local camp = zones and zones:FindFirstChild("Camp")
	local node = camp and camp:FindFirstChild("Node")
	local safeRadius = self.Forest:GetAttribute("CampSafeRadius") or 250
	return not node or flat(point - node.Position).Magnitude > safeRadius + TRAP_RADIUS
end

-- Sample the complete ring, not just its centre: an edge over water, an incline,
-- a nearby trunk or a gap invalidates the placement before an item is consumed.
function Controller:_ground(point, character, humanoid, root)
	if not vector(point) or not self:_insideMap(point) or flat(root.Position - point).Magnitude > PLACE_REACH then return nil end
	if math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 5 then return nil end
	local state = humanoid:GetState()
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then return nil end
	local params = self:_queryParams(character, false)
	local centre = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X, root.Position.Y + 2, point.Z), -UP * 12, params)
	if not centre or centre.Material == Enum.Material.Water or centre.Normal.Y < .94 then return nil end
	local height = centre.Position.Y
	if root.Position.Y - height > math.max(5, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * .5 + 1.5) then return nil end
	for index = 0, 15 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 8
		local edge = centre.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * TRAP_RADIUS
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(edge + UP * 3, -UP * 6, params)
		if not hit or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or hit.Normal.Y < .94 or math.abs(hit.Position.Y - height) > .65 then return nil end
		if workspace:Raycast(centre.Position + UP * .8, flat(edge - centre.Position), params) then return nil end
	end
	local overlap = self:_queryParams(character, true)
	local obstacles = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(centre.Position + UP * 1.05), Vector3.new(8.2, 1.3, 8.2), overlap)
	if #obstacles > 0 then return nil end
	return Vector3.new(point.X, height + .05, point.Z)
end

function Controller:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial, point)
	self:_clearAction()
	local action = {
		Character = character, Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root, Serial = serial,
		Origin = root.Position, Point = point, LastHealth = humanoid.Health, Damaged = false,
	}
	action.HealthConnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < action.LastHealth then action.Damaged = true end
		action.LastHealth = health
	end)
	self._action = action
end
function Controller:_clearAction()
	if self._action and self._action.HealthConnection then self._action.HealthConnection:Disconnect() end
	self._action = nil
	if self._preview then self._preview:Destroy(); self._preview = nil end
end
function Controller:Cancel(reason)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	local hadAction = self.Run.Action ~= nil or self._action ~= nil
	self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run)
	self:_clearAction()
	if hadAction then self:_message(reason) end
	self:_publish()
end

function Controller:RequestPlace(now)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor()
	if not character then return self:_reject("ItemsBlocked") end
	-- Refuse repeated requests before the ring's ground/obstacle queries.
	if self.Run.Action then return self:_reject("Busy") end
	if self.Run.ActiveTrap then return self:_reject("TrapActive") end
	if self.Run.Traps <= 0 then return self:_reject("NoTraps") end
	local look = flat(root.CFrame.LookVector)
	if look.Magnitude < .01 then return self:_reject("InvalidGround") end
	local point = self:_ground(root.Position + look.Unit * 4.25, character, humanoid, root)
	if not point then return self:_reject("InvalidGround") end
	local accepted, reason, serial = self.Rules.beginPlace(self.Run, now)
	if not accepted then return self:_reject(reason) end
	self:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial or self.Run.Action.Serial, point)
	local preview = decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "TrapPlacement", Vector3.new(8, .07, 8), CFrame.new(point), Color3.fromRGB(211, 173, 86), self._folder)
	preview.Transparency = .7; preview.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	self._preview = preview
	self:_publish()
	return true
end

function Controller:_mouth(character, root)
	local point = self.Combat:GetCapturePoint()
	if not vector(point) then return nil, "NotTrapped" end
	if (root.Position - point).Magnitude > CAPTURE_REACH then return nil, "TooFar" end
	local delta = point - (root.Position + UP * .5)
	if delta.Magnitude > .01 and workspace:Raycast(root.Position + UP * .5, delta, self:_queryParams(character, false)) then
		return nil, "Obstructed"
	end
	return point
end
function Controller:RequestCapture(now)
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_actor()
	if not character then return self:_reject("ItemsBlocked") end
	local space,spaceReason=self:_capacity();if not space then return self:_reject(spaceReason) end
	local point, reason = self:_mouth(character, root)
	if not point then return self:_reject(reason) end
	local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
	local accepted, ruleReason, serial = self.Rules.beginCapture(self.Run, now, health.Health, health.MaxHealth)
	if not accepted then return self:_reject(ruleReason) end
	self:_remember(character, humanoid, root, serial or self.Run.Action.Serial, point)
	self:_publish() -- Pause the owner's pet as soon as the drinking action begins.
	return true
end

function Controller:_createTrap(trap, point)
	self:_clearTrap()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "IronTrap"
	model:SetAttribute("QuestRunId", self.Run.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("TrapId", trap.Id)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", self.Player.UserId)
	model.Parent = self._folder
	local copper = Color3.fromRGB(189, 126, 66)
	for index = 0, 15 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 8
		local at = point + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * TRAP_RADIUS, .11, math.sin(angle) * TRAP_RADIUS)
		local bar = decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "IronRing", Vector3.new(.24, .16, 1.64), CFrame.lookAt(at, point + UP * .11) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi * .5, 0), copper, model)
		bar.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		local tooth = decorate(Instance.new("WedgePart"), "IronTooth", Vector3.new(.4, .65, .7), CFrame.lookAt(at + UP * .22, point + UP * .33), Color3.fromRGB(92, 103, 104), model)
		tooth.Material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate
	end
	decorate(Instance.new("Part"), "TriggerPlate", Vector3.new(2.2, .15, 2.2), CFrame.new(point + UP * .1), Color3.fromRGB(80, 89, 91), model)
	self._trapModel, self._trapPoint, self._trapId = model, point, trap.Id
end
function Controller:_clearTrap()
	if self._trapModel then self._trapModel:Destroy(); self._trapModel = nil end
	self._trapPoint, self._trapId = nil, nil
	if self._held then self.Combat:ReleaseTrap(self.Run.Id); self._held = false end
	if self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
end
function Controller:_marker(point)
	if not self._mouthMarker then

function Controller:_publish()
	local run, action, trap = self.Run, self.Run.Action, self.Run.ActiveTrap
	local hunting = not self._destroyed and run.State == "Hunting"
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntAction", if hunting and action then action.Kind else "")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntActionEnds", if hunting and action then action.FinishAt else 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCaptureActive", hunting and action ~= nil and action.Kind == "Capture")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTrapState", if hunting and trap then trap.State else "")
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTrapEnds", if hunting and trap then trap.HeldUntil or trap.ExpiresAt else 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntTraps", run.Traps or 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntPotions", run.Potions or 0)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCaptureAvailable", hunting and self._captureAvailable == true)
	attribute(self.Player, "HuntCapturePoint", if hunting then self._capturePoint else nil)
end

function Controller:Step(now, _dt)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	if self.Run.State ~= "Hunting" then
		self:Cancel()
		self:_clearTrap()
		self._captureAvailable, self._capturePoint = false, nil
		self:_publish()
		return
	end
	local trap = self.Run.ActiveTrap
	if self._trapId and (not trap or trap.Id ~= self._trapId) then self:_clearTrap() end
	if trap and self._trapPoint and trap.State == "Waiting" and now <= trap.ExpiresAt then
		local support = self.Combat:GetSupportPoint()
		local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
		if health.Health > 0 and vector(support) and flat(support - self._trapPoint).Magnitude <= TRIGGER_RADIUS
			and math.abs(support.Y - self._trapPoint.Y) <= 5 then
			local accepted = self.Rules.triggerTrap(self.Run, now)
			if accepted then
				self._held = self.Combat:TrapFor(self.Run.Id, trap.HeldUntil) == true
				if self._held then
					self._trapModel:SetAttribute("Triggered", true)
					if self.OnMessage then self.OnMessage("Iron Trap đã giữ mục tiêu trong 13 giây. Còn sống và máu ≤10% mới cho uống được.") end
				else
					-- Another terminal change can win before acquisition. Never leave a
					-- fictitious Holding state from which a potion could capture it.
					self.Run.ActiveTrap = nil
					self:Cancel()
					self:_clearTrap()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	trap = self.Run.ActiveTrap
	if trap and trap.State == "Holding" and now <= trap.HeldUntil and self._held then
		local point = self.Combat:GetCapturePoint()
		self._capturePoint = if vector(point) then point else nil
		if self._capturePoint then self:_marker(self._capturePoint)
		elseif self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
	else
		self._capturePoint = nil
		if self._mouthMarker then self._mouthMarker:Destroy(); self._mouthMarker = nil end
	end

	self._captureAvailable = false
	if character and self._capturePoint then
		local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
		self._captureAvailable = self:_capacity() and health.Health > 0 and health.Health <= health.MaxHealth * .1
			and self.Run.Potions > 0 and (root.Position - self._capturePoint).Magnitude <= CAPTURE_REACH
			and self:_mouth(character, root) ~= nil
	end
	local action, remembered = self.Run.Action, self._action
	if not action then
		self:_clearAction()
	elseif not remembered or remembered.Serial ~= action.Serial then
		self:Cancel()
	elseif not character or character ~= remembered.Character or humanoid ~= remembered.Humanoid or root ~= remembered.Root then
		self:Cancel("ItemsBlocked")
	elseif remembered.Damaged or humanoid.Health < remembered.LastHealth then
		self:Cancel("Damaged")
	elseif action.Kind == "Place" then
		if (root.Position - remembered.Origin).Magnitude > 1.6 then
			self:Cancel("Moved")
		elseif now >= action.FinishAt then
			local point = self:_ground(remembered.Point, character, humanoid, root)
			if not point or (point - remembered.Point).Magnitude > .7 then
				self:Cancel("InvalidGround")
			else
				local placed, reason = self.Rules.commitPlace(self.Run, now, remembered.Serial)
				self:_clearAction()
				if placed then self:_createTrap(placed, point)
				else self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run); self:_message(reason) end
			end
		end
	elseif action.Kind == "Capture" then
		local point, reason = self:_mouth(character, root)
		local space,spaceReason=self:_capacity()
		if not space then self:Cancel(spaceReason)
		elseif not point or not self._held or not trap or trap.State ~= "Holding" or now > trap.HeldUntil then
			self:Cancel(reason or "TrapEscaped")
		else
			local health = self.Combat:GetSnapshot()
			if health.Health <= 0 or health.Health > health.MaxHealth * .1 then
				self:Cancel(if health.Health <= 0 then "InvalidHealth" else "NotWeak")
			elseif now >= action.FinishAt then
				local captured, result = self.Rules.commitCapture(self.Run, now, health.Health, health.MaxHealth, remembered.Serial)
				self:_clearAction()

					if self.OnCapture then self.OnCapture() end
					self:_clearTrap()
				else
					self.Rules.cancelAction(self.Run)
					self:_message(result)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_publish()
end

function Controller:GetSnapshot()
	local action, trap = self.Run.Action, self.Run.ActiveTrap
	return {
		Action = if action then action.Kind else "", ActionEnds = if action then action.FinishAt else 0,
		TrapState = if trap then trap.State else "", TrapEnds = if trap then trap.HeldUntil or trap.ExpiresAt else 0,
		TrapPoint = self._trapPoint, CapturePoint = self._capturePoint, CaptureAvailable = self._captureAvailable,
		Traps = self.Run.Traps, Potions = self.Run.Potions, Held = self._held == true,
	}
end
function Controller:Destroy()
	if self._destroyed then return end
	self:Cancel()
	self:_clearTrap()
	self._destroyed = true
	self._captureAvailable, self._capturePoint = false, nil
	if self._folder then self._folder:Destroy() end
	self:_publish()
end

return Controller
